source.why_this_clip: A yellow fire hydrant stands large in the right half of the frame while a firefighter bends over it and works a fitting on its side nozzle with his hands; the hydrant itself does not move and the camera is locked off. The frame differences show no spikes, but the sheet shows cuts near 7.0 s and 8.0 s, so the interval is taken from the first continuous stretch, ending at 4.0 s before the man swings round and covers more of the hydrant.
